Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Clarinda

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Clarinda. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

We know what the south-east's heat, UV and hailstorms do to a roof over the years, so we quote on what your home actually needs. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Clarinda: What We Commonly See

Clarinda is a quiet, established south-east suburb of mostly post-war brick homes set between Clayton, Heatherton and Moorabbin. A large share of them still have their original roofs, now faded and weathered after decades of hot summers and harsh UV.

There is no salt this far inland, but Clarinda gets the south-east's hailstorms, which dent metal and crack older roofing, and mature trees that drop leaves into gutters and valleys. The jobs we see most here are refixing cracked ridge capping, re-roofing worn-out roofs, fixing storm damage, and clearing or replacing tired guttering.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Clarinda

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Clarinda homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and built to handle Melbourne's heat, UV and hailstorms, in a colour that suits your home.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Clarinda

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that let water in: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. After a hailstorm or a run of hot summers these are often the first things to fail, and we trace each leak back to its real source rather than patching the ceiling stain.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Clarinda

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Clarinda Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Clarinda Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Browse the COLORBOND® colour chart to start picturing your new roof.

Clarinda Roofing FAQs

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
